Create Bayesian Forest Plot for Meta-Analysis

Source: R/bayes_forest.R
bayes_forest.Rd

Creates a Bayesian forest plot for meta-analysis using a fitted Bayesian model. Supports multiple backends (brms, MetaStan, bayesmeta, rstanarm, rstan, cmdstanr, bayesma, RoBMA, R2jags) and both common-effect and random-effect models.

Usage

bayes_forest(
  model,
  data,
  measure,
  studyvar = NULL,
  yearvar = NULL,
  n_ctrl = NULL,
  n_int = NULL,
  event_ctrl = NULL,
  event_int = NULL,
  mean_ctrl = NULL,
  mean_int = NULL,
  sd_ctrl = NULL,
  sd_int = NULL,
  time_ctrl = NULL,
  time_int = NULL,
  sort_studies_by = "author",
  model_type = c("random_effect", "common_effect"),
  re_min_k = NULL,
  subgroup = FALSE,
  subgroupvar = NULL,
  sort_subgroup_by = "alphabetical",
  label_outcome = "Outcome",
  label_control = "Control",
  label_intervention = "Intervention",
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  title_align = "left",
  xlim = NULL,
  x_breaks = NULL,
  x_label = NULL,
  effect_label = NULL,
  add_rope = FALSE,
  rope_value = NULL,
  rope_color = "grey50",
  plot_output = c("density", "boxplot"),
  shrinkage_output = c("density", "pointinterval"),
  null_value = NULL,
  color_palette = NULL,
  color_study_posterior_null_left = "deepskyblue",
  color_study_posterior_null_right = "violet",
  color_study_posterior = "dodgerblue",
  color_study_posterior_outline = "blue",
  color_overall_posterior = "blue",
  color_shrinkage_pointinterval = "purple",
  color_shrinkage_outline = "purple",
  color_shrinkage_fill = NULL,
  split_color_by_null = FALSE,
  color_favours_control = "firebrick",
  color_favours_intervention = "dodgerblue",
  add_arm_labels = TRUE,
  reverse_arm_labels = FALSE,
  add_pred = FALSE,
  add_pred_subgroup = FALSE,
  pred_output = c("density", "pointinterval", "boxplot"),
  color_pred_posterior = "orange",
  color_pred_outline = "darkorange2",
  color_pred_pointinterval = "orange",
  plot_width = 4,
  add_rob = FALSE,
  rob_tool = "rob2",
  add_rob_legend = FALSE,
  exclude_high_rob = FALSE,
  font = NULL
)

Arguments

model

A fitted Bayesian meta-analysis model object. Supported classes: brmsfit (brms), meta_stan (MetaStan), bayesmeta, stanreg (rstanarm), stanfit (rstan), CmdStanMCMC (cmdstanr), bayesma (bayesma), brma (RoBMA), rjags (R2jags/JAGS).

data

A data frame containing the study data used for the meta-analysis.

measure

Character string specifying the effect measure. Must be one of: "OR" (Odds Ratio), "HR" (Hazard Ratio), "RR" (Risk Ratio), "IRR" (Incidence Rate Ratio), "MD" (Mean Difference), or "SMD" (Standardized Mean Difference).

studyvar

Column name containing study identifiers/authors.

yearvar

Column name containing publication years. Default is NULL.

n_ctrl

Column name containing control group sample sizes.

n_int

Column name containing intervention group sample sizes.

event_ctrl

Column name containing control group event counts.

event_int

Column name containing intervention group event counts.

mean_ctrl

Column name containing control group means.

mean_int

Column name containing intervention group means.

sd_ctrl

Column name containing control group standard deviations.

sd_int

Column name containing intervention group standard deviations.

time_ctrl

Column name containing control group time periods.

time_int

Column name containing intervention group time periods.

sort_studies_by

Character string specifying how to sort studies. Options: "author" (default), "year", or "effect".

model_type

Pooling type used to draw the plot: "random_effect" or "common_effect". If not supplied, it is detected from model.

re_min_k

Optional minimum number of studies for a random-effect model. Between-study heterogeneity (tau) is poorly identified when there are few studies. If re_min_k is set and there are fewer studies than this, a random-effect model_type is switched to "common_effect" with a warning. bayesma models are refit as common-effect (overall and per subgroup); for other backends only the plot changes, as the pooled estimate still comes from the fitted random-effect model, so refit the model as common-effect yourself. Default is NULL (no minimum). An alternative is to keep re_min_k = NULL and fit the model with an informative prior on tau.

subgroup

Logical indicating whether to create subgroup analysis. Default is FALSE.

subgroupvar

Column name in data to use for subgroup analysis.

sort_subgroup_by

Character string or vector specifying subgroup ordering.

label_outcome

Character string for outcome label. Default is "Outcome".

label_control

Character string for control group label. Default is "Control".

label_intervention

Character string for intervention group label. Default is "Intervention".

title

Character string for the plot title. Default is NULL (no title).

subtitle

Character string for the plot subtitle. Default is NULL (no subtitle).

title_align

Character string specifying title alignment.

xlim

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying x-axis limits. Default is NULL.

x_breaks

Numeric vector specifying custom x-axis break points. Default is NULL.

x_label

Character string for the x-axis label. Default is NULL (measure-specific label).

effect_label

Character string used for the effect columns in the right-hand table. Default is NULL (uses measure).

add_rope

Logical indicating whether to add ROPE. Default is FALSE.

rope_value

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying ROPE range.

rope_color

Color for ROPE shading.

plot_output

Character string specifying how study and pooled effects are drawn: "density" (default) or "boxplot". Boxplots are horizontal: the box spans the interquartile range, the line marks the median, and the whiskers span the 95% interval. With "boxplot", shrinkage_output must be "pointinterval" (it is set automatically if not supplied).

shrinkage_output

Character string specifying shrinkage visualization. Options: "density" (default) or "pointinterval". Ignored for common-effect models.

null_value

Numeric value specifying x-axis value of the null line. Default is NULL.

color_palette

Character vector of colors for the plot. Default is NULL.

color_study_posterior_null_left

Color for left side of null study posteriors.

color_study_posterior_null_right

Color for right side of null study posteriors.

color_study_posterior

Color for study posterior densities.

color_study_posterior_outline

Color for study posterior outlines.

color_overall_posterior

Color for overall posterior.

color_shrinkage_pointinterval

Color for point intervals.

color_shrinkage_outline

Color for shrinkage plot outlines.

color_shrinkage_fill

Color for shrinkage plot fill.

split_color_by_null

Logical. Split posterior densities by null value. For boxplots, each box is coloured by which side of the null its median falls.

color_favours_control

Colour for density regions favouring the control group.

color_favours_intervention

Colour for density regions favouring the intervention group.

add_arm_labels

Logical. Whether to show "Favours Control/Intervention" labels. Default is TRUE.

reverse_arm_labels

Logical. Whether to swap the arm label positions. Default is FALSE.

add_pred

Logical. Whether to add a predictive distribution for a new study. Default is FALSE. Only applicable to random-effect models.

add_pred_subgroup

Logical. Whether to add prediction to each subgroup. Default is FALSE.

pred_output

Character string specifying prediction visualization. Options: "density" (default), "pointinterval", or "boxplot". When plot_output = "boxplot", pred_output defaults to "boxplot" too unless explicitly set.

color_pred_posterior

Color for prediction density fill. Default is "orange".

color_pred_outline

Color for prediction density outline. Default is "darkorange2".

color_pred_pointinterval

Color for prediction point interval. Default is "orange".

plot_width

Numeric value specifying the relative width of the plot component. Default is 4.

add_rob

Logical indicating whether to add Risk of Bias assessment. Default is FALSE.

rob_tool

Risk of bias tool: "rob2" (default), "robins_i", "robins_e", "quadas2", "clarity", "rob_nma", "probast", or "probast_ai". See rob_plot() for the domain columns each tool expects.

add_rob_legend

Logical indicating whether to add RoB legend. Default is FALSE.

exclude_high_rob

Logical indicating whether to exclude studies with a high overall risk of bias ("High", "Serious", "Critical", "Very high" or "Definitely high") and refit the model. Requires an overall RoB column.

font

Character string specifying the font family. Default is NULL.

Value

A patchwork object containing the complete forest plot.
